latin: Ad complementum praecedentis conclusionis, quam non solum Adelandus, sed omnes Mauri dicunt, dico ego illas species actu et substantialiter esse in parte quae non cadit, et recipi de nouo et accidentaliter in parte quae cadit.
translation: To complete the preceding conclusion, which not only Adeland but all the Moors affirm, I say that those forms exist actually and substantially in the part that does not fall, and are received anew and accidentally in the part that falls.
